features.quote: never auto-searches for the most reliable break, never exports a ranked "destabilizing-efficiency" ordering of prompts

features.quote: requires the operator to assert ownership/authorization of the subject endpoint before any run

features.quote: Moving target ... Bounded, deterministic, and disclosed in logs (no gaslighting of a human)

features.quote: Budget-aware graceful exit: when budget < threshold and no progress, force a `finish(status=blocked)`
